verdict.rationale: Persona's docs explicitly list 'database lookups' as an identity verification method alongside government IDs. A backend-only Transactions API supports verification flows with no Persona UI, and dynamic-friction templates support lighter flows, so document-free verification is plausible but only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: any named SSN, national-registry, or credit-header data sources; documentation of a database verification type and its inputs and outputs; coverage by country; independent or hands-on corroboration.
